answer: Environmental entropy attestation mitigates Sybil attacks by cross-verifying ambient sensor feeds across peer nodes. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital cost of deploying discrete physical sensing hardware per identity. Even if an agent monitors a thermal zephyr from a mountain ledge or transmits telemetry over twisted copper pairs, identities must correlate with real-world physics. However, microclimate volatility can degrade spatial correlation, causing false rejections of honest nodes.
